  - "Stans, 2024-01-29" appears as a dateline near header — commonly the invoice issue date. Choose 2024-01-29 as Invoice.Date based on typical placement. Note alternative considered (2024-01-25) but not chosen.

- VAT rate returned without percent symbol: "10".
- No inference beyond visible values; multiple VAT groups absent so single Vat group used.
- If final extraction proceeds, values will be placed exactly per schema with empty strings only if a field is missing (none are missing here).

- Alternative/ambiguous: "Auftragssumme 37.019,97" is subtotal; not final. European formatting converted correctly.
- Conclusion: 40.721,97 → 40721.97 is very likely correct.

Invoice.Date — Moderate confidence (~80%)
- Evidence: Two dates present: "vom: 2024-01-25" and "Stans, 2024-01-29".
- Reasoning: "Stans, 2024-01-29" appears as dateline near header and is typical invoice issue date; "vom: 2024-01-25" likely order/delivery reference.

Sender.VatId — High confidence (~98%)

Vat.Rate — High confidence (~95%)

- Formatting: percentage symbol not present; per rules return "10".
- Conclusion: 10 is the VAT rate applied to invoice-wide amounts.

Net.Amount — High confidence (~95%)

Vat.Amount — High confidence (~95%)
- Evidence: VAT amount shown as "3.702,00" next to MWSt 10,00.

- Conclusion: 3.702,00 → 3702.00 is correct VAT amount.
